presets.name: Jezero Crater — Perseverance
presets.scenario: Crewed EVA from a habitat near the Mars 2020 landing site toward the western delta front and Seitah to sample ancient lake sediments. Scenario not yet confirmed by the team.

presets.name: Gale Crater, Mount Sharp — Curiosity
presets.scenario: Crewed EVA from Bradbury Landing toward the lower slopes of Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons) along the Curiosity traverse corridor. Scenario not yet confirmed by the team.
